{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
file_path = '/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/sales.csv'
data = pd.read_csv(file_path)

# Convert revenue to float after removing commas
# Even though no commas were found, do it safely
data['revenue_clean'] = data['revenue'].str.replace(',', '', regex=False).astype(float)

# Filter to completed orders (exclude refunded)
completed_orders = data[data['status'] == 'completed']

# Check for QA orders (revenue = 999999.99)
qa_orders = completed_orders[completed_orders['revenue_clean'] == 999999.99]
print(f'Number of QA orders in completed dataset: {len(qa_orders)}')

# Exclude QA orders
valid_orders = completed_orders[completed_orders['revenue_clean'] != 999999.99]

# Check channel distribution
print('\nChannel distribution in valid orders:')
print(valid_orders['channel'].value_counts())

# Check customer_segment distribution by channel
print('\nCustomer segment by channel:')
print(valid_orders.groupby('channel')['customer_segment'].value_counts())

# Compute conversion rate for each channel
# Conversion rate = converted == 1
email_conversion_rate = valid_orders[valid_orders['channel'] == 'email']['converted'].mean()
paid_search_conversion_rate = valid_orders[valid_orders['channel'] == 'paid_search']['converted'].mean()

# Compute difference in conversion rates
difference = email_conversion_rate - paid_search_conversion_rate

# Output results
print(f'\nEmail conversion rate: {email_conversion_rate:.4f}')
print(f'Paid search conversion rate: {paid_search_conversion_rate:.4f}')
print(f'Difference (email - paid_search): {difference:.4f}')"}
